enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Remain asleep. Occasionally turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Breathe regularly. Remain in bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Wake up, shower and morning wash
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Make and eat breakfast using the kettle and toaster
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Take out plate and cup. Place bread on plate. Insert bread into toaster. Press lever. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Remove toast from toaster. Spread butter on toast. Pour hot water into cup. Add tea bag. Stir. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Get dressed, pack study materials and check the day's class timetable on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Put on clothes. Open backpack. Put in books, laptop, charger, notebook, pen. Zip backpack. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open timetable. Read timetable. Turn off computer. Pick up backpack. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commute to the Monash University campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Check bus schedule on phone. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Put backpack on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at campus. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to campus building.

enriched_activities.activity: Attend Master of Education lectures and seminars on campus
enriched_activities.desc: Enter lecture hall. Find seat. Sit down. Take out notebook and pen. Listen to lecturer. Write notes. Raise hand. Ask question. Listen to answer. Continue writing. Check phone. Take break. Stand up. Walk out. Walk back. Sit down. Continue lecture.

enriched_activities.activity: Study in the campus library and review lecture notes on the laptop
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to library. Find empty table. Sit down. Open backpack. Take out laptop. Turn on laptop. Open lecture notes. Read notes. Highlight key points. Type summary. Check references. Close laptop. Pack laptop. Stand up. Walk out of library.
Walk to cafeteria. Queue. Order food. Pay. Receive food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Return tray. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Attend afternoon tutorials and work on education coursework assignments
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to tutorial room. Sit down. Take out materials. Participate in discussion. Take notes. Open laptop. Work on assignment. Ask tutor questions. Listen to answers. Continue working. Save file. Close laptop. Pack up. Stand up. Walk out.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Put backpack on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at home stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Prepare and eat dinner using the microwave and oven, avoiding the induction cooker during the evening grid peak
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Open microwave. Place food in microwave. Set timer. Press start. Open oven. Place food in oven. Set timer. Take out food from microwave. Take out food from oven. Place on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Apply deodorant. Comb hair. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Study course readings and complete assignment work on the computer under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Open textbook. Read chapter. Take notes. Open assignment file. Type answers. Check references. Save file. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.
Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Change channels. Find show. Sit on couch. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch more. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Brush teeth and complete nightly wash routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Change into pajamas. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Set alarm on phone. Put phone on bedside table. Turn off lamp. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Adjust pillow. Turn to side. Breathe deeply. Remain asleep.
